items.headline: Securities fraud class action proceeds against Planet Fitness over 31% stock drop
items.summary: Investors allege PLNT oversold a marketing campaign that alienated beginner members, so the franchisor now carries a legal overhang alongside its join-rate problem.

items.headline: Planet Fitness shares off 53% in a year as member additions keep undershooting
items.summary: PLNT's join rates and share price keep sliding, which sets a cautious backdrop for Bravo Fit's club build-out economics.

items.headline: Planet Fitness franchisee EBITDA margin falls to 67.6% from 72.3%
items.summary: Franchisee-level EBITDA margin dropped ~470bps on higher advertising and equipment costs, a direct read on the unit economics Bravo Fit inherits.

items.headline: Planet Fitness appoints Sudhanshu Priyadarshi CFO and President, International
items.summary: New international leadership is the counterparty for Bravo Fit's development pipeline â€” worth an early relationship.

items.headline: Franchise Equity Partners acquires Bravo Fit, Planet Fitness' Australian franchisee
items.summary: 32 clubs today with exclusive development rights for ~100 more across VIC, NSW, SA, QLD and ACT; targeting 135+ clubs.
